error.machineGone: That machine is no longer in the list
error.machineDisconnected: That machine is no longer connected
error.idsTaken: This canvas is already open from another checkout. Close that project first, or both share terminals and chats.

close.idle: Nothing is running. It moves to Recent as you left it.
close.ending_one: Closing ends its running session. Terminals lose scrollback and agents stop.
close.ending_other: Closing ends its {{count}} running sessions. Terminals lose scrollback and agents stop.
close.held_one: This project is still open on another device, so nothing stops. It moves to Recent here only.
close.held_other: This project is still open on {{count}} other devices, so nothing stops. It moves to Recent here only.

diagram.draft: Fill the empty diagram "{{name}}" with `ruimte-context view diagram {{viewId}}`. It should show

moveChat.failedToRender: The move dialog could not be shown
moveChat.name: Name
moveChat.conflict: {{name}} is already in {{project}}. Leave the files in Chats, or rename it there first.
moveChat.references_one: A chat in Chats refers to this one with @ and loses access after the move.
moveChat.references_other: {{count}} chats in Chats refer to this one with @ and lose access after the move.
moveChat.infoFailed: The machine could not say where this chat worked

refusal.not-in-chats: Only a chat in Chats can move to a project.
refusal.working: This chat is still working. Stop it or let it finish first.
refusal.agents: A chat with agents cannot move to a project yet.
refusal.tasks: A chat with tasks cannot move to a project yet.
refusal.owedAt: This chat resumes by itself at {{time}}. Write in it or turn off resuming first.
refusal.owed: The machine still has work queued for this chat. Try again once it is done.
refusal.messages: Messages from other chats wait for its next turn. Move it after that.
refusal.pr-watch: This chat watches a pull request. Stop watching it first.
